svg.title: Package topology
svg.desc: The 16 workspace members in six tiers, T0 kernel at the bottom to T5 dev-only gates at the top. Arrows are direct production dependencies after transitive reduction and every arrow points strictly down a tier. Only the CLI depends on the runtime; the ACP adapter sits beside the runtime and the CLI composes both.

g.text: Hover a package for what it owns and its direct dependencies; its edges light up. Click it to open its row in the package table.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: An import may only point at a strictly lower tier. Same-tier edges are forbidden, so channels cannot see each other or the runtime.

g.text: dartclaw_fitness · repo-wide architecture gates in dev/fitness/test
Direct: none. Scans source as text.
Direct: core, kernel. Reached only via dev_dependencies, not a tier edge. lib LOC ceiling 5026.
dartclaw_cli · thin command layer: serve, workflow, tasks, config, sessions, maintenance
Direct: acp, client, core, google_chat, kernel, runtime, search, slack, workflow. Only member that composes a binary. lib LOC ceiling 14480.
DartclawRuntime.build · HTTP API and web UI · task runtime · container orchestration · MCP server
dartclaw_runtime · the server-only service graph; the one package that reaches the workflow engine, the channels, search and the bridge
Direct: bridge, core, google_chat, kernel, search, signal, slack, whatsapp, workflow. Only the CLI uses it in production. lib LOC ceiling 79050.
dartclaw_acp · ACP client and harness; implements the HarnessRegistrar contract that core owns
Direct: core, kernel. The runtime never imports it (same tier). lib LOC ceiling 3646.
dartclaw · umbrella re-export of dartclaw_client and a part of dartclaw_kernel
Direct: client, kernel. Never re-exports runtime packages. lib LOC ceiling 58.
dartclaw_workflow · definitions, parser and validator, registry, execution engine
Direct: core, kernel. Framework-agnostic: the runtime and the standalone CLI both compose it. lib LOC ceiling 26799.
google_chat · Google Chat adapter with its sidecar or transport client and config parsing
Direct: core, kernel. Siblings cannot import each other. lib LOC ceiling 7509.
slack · Slack adapter (Socket Mode and Events API) with its sidecar or transport client and config parsing
Direct: core, kernel. Siblings cannot import each other. lib LOC ceiling 3077.
signal · Signal adapter with its sidecar or transport client and config parsing
Direct: core, kernel. Siblings cannot import each other. lib LOC ceiling 1796.
whatsapp · WhatsApp adapter with its sidecar or transport client and config parsing
Direct: core, kernel. Siblings cannot import each other. lib LOC ceiling 1184.
dartclaw_client · HTTP and SSE client with transport DTOs (DartclawApiClient)
Direct: none. Zero deps: client to core would be same-tier. lib LOC ceiling 625.
dartclaw_search · HybridSearch, VectorSynchronizer and embedding providers over injected indexes
Direct: kernel. Owns no corpus and no database driver. lib LOC ceiling 1979.
dartclaw_bridge · framed stdio bridge protocol and the in-container loopback bridge executable
Direct: none. Zero deps by gate: compile exe rejects build hooks. lib LOC ceiling 928.
Direct: kernel. No server or workflow dependency. lib LOC ceiling 32652.
models, typed configuration, guards, audit and redaction primitives, PlatformCapabilities, shared utilities · depends on nothing
dartclaw_kernel · shared data, typed configuration and guards
Direct: none. No EventBus, so guards and typed config work without server wiring. lib LOC ceiling 21444.
direct production dependency, transitively reduced; each points to a lower tier
